basic_info.description: A spacious and open-floor-plan condo in Outer Sunset with stunning ocean views is now available! This 1,600 sqft. home features 4 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. Recently painted, the unit boasts new light fixtures and mirrors in the primary and hall bathrooms, along with stainless steel kitchen appliances, hardwood cabinets and floors, an in-unit washer and dryer, and shared basement garage parking. Ideally located just 100 feet from shops, banks, and other retail, and only a block away from a supermarket and additional conveniences. Dont miss this opportunity to enjoy everything the Sunset has to offer!
